title_as_printed: New Vapor Phase Data for Ethane-Water Binary
pressure_note: column headed 'Pressure, p.s.i.a.' (absolute); treated as total pressure of the two-phase cell (p.21 phase-rule statement)

conversion_needs: temperature is printed only on the first row of each block and must be filled down (blank cells in the CSV): rows 0-8 100.1/99.9 block (row 0 100.1, rows 1-8 99.9 as printed on row 1 and carried), rows 9-15 160 F block (printed 160.1, 160.0, 160.1, [blank], 160.2, 160.1, [blank]), rows 16-19 220 F block (220.0, 220.1, [blank], 220.2)
notes: Temperature fill-down: a blank T takes the last printed T above it (row 0 100.1; rows 1-8 99.9; row 9 160.1, row 10 160.0, row 11 160.1, row 12 160.1, row 13 160.2, row 14 160.1, row 15 160.1; row 16 220.0, row 17 220.1, row 18 220.1, row 19 220.2). Text says binary data taken at 100, 160 and 220 F. No standard-conditions definition needed.
